cost_assessment: Individually authored concise rationale for this hypothetical cost overrun, not algorithmically produced prose.
geometry_assessment: Individually authored concise rationale for this hypothetical deviation and its relation to the cost case.
related_ids: Same-condition history plus other nearby scenario records; automatically listed IDs are references, not a replacement for authored judgments.
revision_rule: Keep original authored files. Append revision entries with original values, new values, grounds and affected statistics; never rewrite earlier review history.
review_scope: Internal plausibility and consistency, not physical validation or reconstructed measurements.
